servinfo.title: Lane departure prevention function cannot be switched ON or OFF (lane departure prevention model)

attention3.ptxt: Dual sensor brake support system is controlled by dual sensor brake support control module communicating with the following control modules through CAN communication. Before performing symptom diagnosis, check that no DTC is indicated in these control modules.
